blendVariants.label: Sun Grown
blendVariants.title: Hemingway Classic Sun Grown
blendVariants.summaryHtml: Cedar, leather, toasted wood, caramel, red pepper and citrus peel give the Classic Sun Grown a firmer, spicier edge than the Cameroon-wrapped Natural while retaining the Hemingway line’s aromatic Dominican core. The Ecuadorian sun-grown wrapper adds darker sweetness and pepper around the cedar, with the long perfecto shape allowing the profile to broaden before a woody, savoury-sweet finish.
blendVariants.noteHtml: Untasted. Price follows the catalogue’s existing Hemingway Classic convention of treating one 7-inch cigar as two pre-light sessions.
practicalLines: Pre-cut before lighting into two sessions
